workarounds.symptom: Package-load worker occasionally hangs until the 240s job timeout under concurrent loads
workarounds.workaround: Fix: perf(server): plan the package entities in the load worker. Target files: packages/server/src/package_load/package_load_pool.spec.ts, packages/server/src/package_load/package_load_pool.ts, packages/server/src/package_load/package_load_worker.ts. . Follows #1564. (Ref: https://github.com/malloydata/publisher/pull/1565)

workarounds.symptom: Filter-binding check refuses an inherited where: on composite sources (403 since 0.8.1)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): read composite fields through to the resolved member in the filter-binding check. Target files: packages/server/src/service/filter_binding_guard.ts, packages/server/src/service/filter_binding_guard_composite.integration.spec.ts, packages/server/src/service/model.ts. Since 0.8.1 the inherited-filter binding check refuses a `where:` on a composite source with `403 Access denied for source "<member>"`, although nothing in the package is gated: (Ref: https://github.com/malloydata/publisher/pull/1278)
